source.path: solution/3600-3699/3617.Find Students with Study Spiral Pattern/Solution.sql

inspiration.observed_pattern: A series of CTEs ranks rows per entity, uses LAG and a cumulative SUM to split date gaps into groups, then aggregates each group and filters qualifying sequences.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a learner topic-session report. LAG detects gaps longer than two days, a cumulative SUM assigns session groups, and grouped results report topic order and study hours for groups with at least three sessions. Pattern-cycle string matching and source identifiers are omitted.

fixture_notes: Learner 41 has a three-session contiguous algebra block and a separate one-session review block; learner 42 has a two-session block that does not qualify. Only qualifying groups are returned.
determinism_notes: Learner IDs, dates, topics, gaps, thresholds, and ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE learning_sessions (session_id INT PRIMARY KEY, learner_id INT NOT NULL, session_date DATE NOT NULL, topic VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, hours_studied INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH ordered_sessions AS (SELECT learner_id, session_date, topic, hours_studied, LAG(session_date) OVER (PARTITION BY learner_id ORDER BY session_date, session_id) AS previous_date FROM learning_sessions), grouped_sessions AS (SELECT learner_id, session_date, topic, hours_studied, SUM(CASE WHEN previous_date IS NULL OR DATEDIFF(session_date, previous_date) > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY learner_id ORDER BY session_date, topic ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS session_group FROM ordered_sessions), summaries AS (SELECT learner_id, session_group, COUNT(*) AS session_count, GROUP_CONCAT(topic ORDER BY session_date SEPARATOR '>') AS topic_sequence, SUM(hours_studied) AS total_hours FROM grouped_sessions GROUP BY learner_id, session_group) SELECT learner_id, session_group, session_count, topic_sequence, total_hours FROM summaries WHERE session_count >= 3 ORDER BY learner_id, session_group
